inventory.scope_source_ref: raw/paper.pdf (16 pages, including End Matter and Supplemental Material) and paper-source/WignerNegativityImpliesGME.tex
inventory.scope_reason: The full paper, End Matter, Supplemental proof sections, captions, and complete TeX/PDF bundle were enumerated. There are no tables or separate supplementary files; no author numerical code or arrays were used.
inventory.scope_next_action: Keep the 46-item W1 denominator stable; W2 may add independent proof checks without changing item identity.

items.source_ref: Main Fig. 1 central 3D cut and End Matter
items.scientific_object: Signed 3D Wigner field on the printed cut.
items.authored_reason: Independent Fock-basis field covers the scientific series; undisclosed isosurface/camera choices are rendering-only.

items.scientific_object: Signed 2D Wigner field, integral, and negative volume.
items.authored_reason: Independent field, parity identity, and convergence checks cover this series.

items.scientific_object: Reduced center-of-mass Wigner field.
items.authored_reason: The reduced density matrix and field are independently generated and normalized.

items.scientific_object: Gaussian-convolved field including its negative origin.
items.authored_reason: Grid convolution and an independent analytic origin value cover the series.

items.scientific_object: Tripartite W-state Wigner field and finite disk.
items.authored_reason: Exact field and disk witness are independently evaluated.

items.scientific_object: W-state characteristic field with 19 difference points.
items.authored_reason: Exact field, point set, and independent eigensolve cover this series.

items.scientific_object: N_2D above the state-dependent bound implies GME for every allowed slice.
items.authored_reason: Examples are checked, but no independent proof-level artifact covers the general theorem.

items.scientific_object: Absolute signed slice integral bound M^{-1}(2/pi)^{M-1}.
items.authored_reason: Only one M=3 state is checked; no all-state proof check exists.

items.scientific_object: Squared-L2 slice bound (2M)^{-1}(2/pi)^{2M-1}.
items.authored_reason: No general norm proof check or counterexample search exists.

items.scientific_object: The bound lies in [0,1/(4sqrt(M-1))+1/(2M)].
items.authored_reason: The M=3 example does not establish the all-M extremal range.

items.scientific_object: Negative smoothed values lower-bound trace distance to non-GME states by 2/pi.
items.authored_reason: One origin value does not independently prove the general trace bound.

items.scientific_object: M-2 auxiliaries map every non-GME state to a nonnegative collective Wigner function.
items.authored_reason: No independent partition construction or falsification check exists.

items.source_ref: Supplement S2, final identity in Theorem 2 proof
items.scientific_object: Smoothed Wigner equals the rescaled extended-state reduced Wigner function.
items.authored_reason: Only one Gaussian M=3 specialization is checked.

items.source_ref: Supplement S2, equation after Theorem 2 proof
items.scientific_object: Kernel equals a scaled reduced Wigner function of the auxiliary product state.
items.authored_reason: No independent general auxiliary-mode check exists.

items.source_ref: Eq. (9) and Supplement S2 final equation
items.scientific_object: Gaussian auxiliaries yield the kernel with sqrt(det Sigma)>=(M-2)/(4M).
items.authored_reason: The existing M=3 check does not establish the all-M covariance constraint.

items.scientific_object: tau_c(tr_-rho)>1-1/M implies GME.
items.authored_reason: No independent general Gaussian-convolution proof check exists.

items.scientific_object: A maximally mixing M-port fed above depth 1-1/M produces GME.
items.authored_reason: No independent interferometer-output entanglement check exists.

items.scientific_object: Finite-region absolute volume above 1/(2sqrt(M-1)) certifies GME.
items.authored_reason: The W-state example is checked, not the general corollary proof.

items.scientific_object: Rigorous discrete Wigner integration requires about 76000 measurements.
items.authored_reason: Imported from the companion paper; derivation and tolerance are absent here.

items.scientific_object: Heuristic integration requires about 78 measurements.
items.authored_reason: The companion sampling rule and tolerance are absent here.

items.scientific_object: A non-PSD C(rho;Xi) circle K(R;Xi) matrix certifies GME.
items.authored_reason: The W-state example is checked, not the all-state Bochner implication.

items.scientific_object: Most-negative witness eigenvalue lower-bounds trace distance to non-GME states.
items.authored_reason: No independent operator-norm/trace-norm proof check exists.

items.scientific_object: The N-point construction needs fewer than N squared measurements.
items.authored_reason: The seven-point example is checked, not the general count bound.

items.source_ref: Final paragraph of Construction of GME criteria
items.scientific_object: Both theorems detect families for every finite M>=3.
items.authored_reason: The construction is deferred to the companion paper and absent here.

items.authored_reason: No robustness definition, curve, or data is included here.
